_README: REI BlackBook selectors, mapped from the confirmed real navigation spec (documented manual walkthrough of my.reiblackbook.com, 2026-08). Text/label selectors preferred; icon-only controls are marked NEEDS-DOM and are tolerant guesses (capture exact via `npx playwright codegen` against the real account). The engine fails closed: any required element not found -> Needs Review, never a send. Confirmed by spec: search is by PHONE (dashed format, e.g. 510-653-9161) with a known first-attempt-often-fails bug (redo click+type+Enter once); the phone-opt-in control is an icon next to the phone number on the About tab (click -> either an 'Opted-Out' tooltip [hard stop] or an 'Opt-In Contact' modal); the ProfitDial 'From:' list is a long VIRTUALIZED dropdown with no search box (must scroll incrementally); Activities + Notes tabs must be checked for STOP/DNC history before doing anything else.

login.submitButton: button[type='submit'], button:has-text('Log In'), button:has-text('Login'), button:has-text('Sign In'), input[type='submit']

contacts.searchInput: input[placeholder*='Search By Name' i], input[placeholder*='Search' i], input[type='search'], input[aria-label*='search' i], .search input
contacts.resultRowLink: table tbody tr td a, .list-row a, [role='row'] a, a[href*='/contacts/']
contacts.noResultsMarker: text=/no result/i, text=/did not match/i, text=/no records/i

contact._status: Contact detail = /contacts/<id>?activeTab=about|chat|activities|notes. Tabs: About | Chat | Activities | Notes | Tasks | Files | Workflows | Properties.
contact._nameField_status: Confirmed from a real screenshot: the 'Contacts (NN)' panel on the About tab has a labeled 'Name' field with the value in the next element. The previous generic h1/h2 guess was matching an unrelated page element (most likely a hidden 'Log Out' menu item) and reading that as the contact's name.
contact._optIn_status: NEEDS-DOM: icon-only control next to the phone number in the left sidebar (Primary Details). Click it -> either 'Phone Opted-Out' tooltip (permanent, hard stop) or an 'Opt-In Contact' modal (not yet asked). There is no separate label until clicked.
contact.phoneOptInIcon: a[href^='tel:'] ~ button, a[href^='tel:'] ~ svg, a[href^='tel:'] ~ i, a[href^='tel:'] + *, [class*='phone-icon' i], [class*='phoneIcon' i], [aria-label*='opt' i][aria-label*='phone' i]
contact.optInModalConfirmButton: button:has-text('Opt-In'), button:has-text('Opt In'), button:has-text('Confirm'), button:has-text('Save'), button:has-text('Yes')
contact._activities_status: Red flags: STOP / DNC / complaint / opt-out / angry-response notes anywhere in the history. A clean record shows only tag-change entries.
contact.activitiesList: .activity-history li, .activity-list li, [class*='activity' i] li, [class*='Activity' i] li, [class*='timeline' i] li, [class*='activity' i] .item, [class*='activity' i] tr
contact._notes_status: Empty state is a specific sentence; anything else must be read for do-not-contact instructions.
contact.notesList: .notes-list li, [class*='note' i] li, [class*='Note' i] .item, [class*='note' i] tr

chat._status: Chat tab. Compose bar has a 'From:' picker — a long VIRTUALIZED list (100+ entries, no search box; must scroll incrementally, expect ~8-10 scroll/read cycles). TinyMCE reply box (often in an iframe). 'Send Text' button. Delivery shows async: plain = sent/delivered, red 'Undelivered' = carrier failure.
chat.editorFrame: iframe.tox-edit-area__iframe, iframe[id*='tiny' i], iframe[title*='Rich Text' i]
chat.messageInput: body#tinymce[contenteditable='true'], .mce-content-body[contenteditable='true'], [data-mce-placeholder*='Write Your Reply' i], [aria-placeholder*='Write Your Reply' i], textarea[placeholder*='Write Your Reply' i], [contenteditable='true'], div[role='textbox']
chat.sendButton: [aria-label='Send Text' i], [title='Send Text' i], button:has-text('Send Text'), [data-testid*='send' i], [aria-label*='send' i], button[title*='send' i], button:has(svg[class*='send' i]), button:has(svg[class*='paper' i])
